patch_description: Introduce per-upload deltas for the RY layer by replacing ry_corner/ry_edge/ry_center parameters with a shared base plus per-upload deltas. Use dummy delta gates to host the delta parameters without changing the circuit, and update the ansatz application to compute final angles as base + delta(upload). This increases expressivity without a large depth increase, aiming to improve validation/test performance and overall score.
